en.headline: Linn unveils stricter pre-approval lists for building maintenance firms
en.dek: Separate lists for survey consultants, supervision consultants and contractors open for applications from 30 September, with background checks and a de-listing mechanism to curb collusion.
body: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said on Saturday that the government would introduce three separate pre-approval lists covering building survey consultants, supervision consultants and contractors for major building maintenance works.
Applications open on 30 September and close on 23 October. The lists are expected to be ready by the end of the year, with tender assistance for owners beginning in the first quarter of 2027.

Linn said the criteria are stricter than the existing "Tender Safe" scheme and include background checks by police and the ICAC, as well as reviews of prosecution records in addition to convictions. Separate lists are intended to prevent collusion among related parties on the same project.

A de-listing mechanism will remove firms convicted of integrity-related offences from receiving new work. Linn said the new arrangements should keep maintenance costs no higher than current levels and improve price transparency for owners.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪推樓宇維修預審名單 準則更嚴防打龍通
zh.dek: 發展局將為驗樓顧問、監工顧問及承建商設立三張獨立預審名單，9月30日起接受申請，目標年底備妥，明年首季協助業主招標。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪周六表示，政府將推出樓宇維修全新支援服務，涵蓋驗樓顧問、工程顧問及承建商三張獨立「預審名單」。
申請期由9月30日起至10月23日結束，目標年底陸續備妥名單，明年首季開始為業主進行項目招標。
甯漢豪指，新準則較現行「招標妥」更嚴謹，除定罪紀錄外亦會審視檢控紀錄，並經警方及廉署背景審查。分開三張名單是為避免「打龍通」及有關聯的三方參與同一大維修項目。
預審名單設除名機制，涉誠信罪行被定罪者會立刻剔除，不會獲派新工程。甯漢豪期望新制度下大維修價錢不應高過現時，並更明碼實價。
